basic.name: 普通攻击：凛冽裁决
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的斩击，第一段造成物理伤害，后四段造成冰属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to five slashes forward, the first dealing Physical DMG, and the following four Ice DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：碎冰溢寒
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，消耗5%当前生命值，使全队角色每秒基于照1.06%最大生命值回复生命值，持续5秒，[特殊技：碎冰溢寒]和[强化特殊技：流霜冻土]的消耗生命效果每30秒最多触发一次。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to 1.06% of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge and EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra can trigger at most once every 30s.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：流霜冻土
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方连续发动斩击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，消耗5%当前生命值，使全队角色每秒基于照1.06%最大生命值回复生命值，持续5秒，[特殊技：碎冰溢寒]和[强化特殊技：流霜冻土]的消耗生命效果每30秒最多触发一次；
招式发动时，积攒20点[霜寒值]，如果[霜寒值]满，消耗所有[霜寒值]，开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]；
招式发动时，如果处于任意[以太帷幕]中，将触发[快速支援]，此时如果发动队友的[快速支援]，照将自动衔接[普通攻击：最终裁决]并进行蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launches multiple forward slashes, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to 1.06% of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge and EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra can trigger at most once every 30s.
Upon activating this skill, gain 20 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：倏忽闪
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动下落斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Performs a falling slash ahead, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：临时合作
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方发动连续斩击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动后，积攒5点[霜寒值]，如果[霜寒值]满，消耗所有[霜寒值]，开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]；
招式发动后，如果处于任意[以太帷幕]中，将触发[快速支援]，此时如果发动队友的[快速支援]，照将自动衔接[普通攻击：最终裁决]并进行蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches multiple slashes in front, dealing massive Ice DMG.
After using this skill, gains 5 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：兔兔连斩
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：

招式发动后，如果处于任意[以太帷幕]中，将触发[快速支援]，此时如果发动队友的[快速支援]，照将自动衔接[普通攻击：最终裁决]并进行蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks in front, followed by a falling slash, dealing massive Ice DMG.
After using this skill, gains 20 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：查漏补缺
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

quickAssist.descriptionEn:

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：霜婵镇场
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
照会额外根据初始最大生命值提高暴击率，每1000点初始最大生命值提高1.4%暴击率；
进入战场时，照获得100点[霜寒值]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次，[霜寒值]的上限为100点；
当前操作中角色攻击命中敌人时，照积攒6点[霜寒值]，每3秒最多触发一次；
[霜寒值]满时，如果处于接战状态下，将照换入前场可以发动[登场技]；
照发动[登场技]时，消耗所有[霜寒值]，开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]；
[以太帷幕·涌泉]生效期间，全队角色最大生命值提升5%，持续40秒，照重复开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]前，将关闭已有的[以太帷幕·涌泉]；
照开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]时，使全队角色的攻击力提升1000点，持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
facts.textEn:
Zhao gains bonus CRIT Rate based on her initial Max HP, gaining 1.4% CRIT Rate for every 1,000 initial Max HP.
Upon entering the battlefield, Zhao gains 100 Frostbite Points. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The maximum amount of Frostbite Points is 100.
When the currently active character's attacks hit an enemy, Zhao gains 6 Frostbite Points. This can be triggered once every 3s.
When Frostbite Points are maxed out, switching Zhao to the field while in combat will activate her Entry Skill.
When Zhao activates her Entry Skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members gain 5% Max HP for 40s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Wellspring ends the existing instance before applying a new Ether Veil: Wellspring.
When Zhao activates Ether Veil: Wellspring, all squad members' ATK increase by 1,000 for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

cinema.name: 凛然裁决
cinema.description: 照被切换为非当前操作角色时，使全队角色造成的伤害无视目标15%全属性伤害抗性，持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Zhao switches out of being the active character, all squad members' DMG ignores 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES for 50s.

cinema.name: 黑枝前辈
cinema.description: 照的生命值回复时，提升20%攻击力，并使队伍中其他角色提升15%攻击力，持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Zhao recovers HP, her ATK increases by 20%, and other squad members' ATK increases by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

cinema.descriptionEn: When Zhao activates an Ether Veil, she gains 250 Decibels. The CRIT DMG of her Ultimate, Chain Attack, and Basic Attack: Final Verdict increase by 40%.

basic.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
预备后进入蓄力，松开时向前方进行斩击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
蓄力时，照将累积最多5秒蓄力时长，[普通攻击：最终裁决]、[连携技]或[支援突击]的终结一击命中时，将消耗蓄力时长造成额外伤害，每有1秒蓄力时长，造成照13%最大生命值的额外伤害；
照处于任意[以太帷幕]中时，如果在蓄力中成为非当前操作中角色，可以继续进行蓄力；
招式发动时，如果[霜寒值]满，消耗所有[霜寒值]，开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]，并触发[快速支援]，此时如果发动队友的[快速支援]，照将自动衔接[普通攻击：最终裁决]并进行蓄力；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
不为当前操作中角色时，招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
After getting ready, Zhao starts charging up, then launches a forward slash on release, dealing massive Ice DMG.
While charging, Zhao accumulates up to 5s of charge time. When the Finishing Move of Basic Attack: Final Verdict, Chain Attack, or Assist Follow-Up hits, the stored charge time is consumed to deal additional DMG. For every 1 second of charge time, Zhao deals 13% of Max HP as additional DMG.
When Zhao is in any Ether Veil, if she gets switched out while charging, the charge can continue.
If Frostbite Points are maxed out when the skill activates, all Frostbite Points are consumed to trigger Ether Veil: Wellspring and a Quick Assist. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While not the currently controlled character, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：弹跳冲刺
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动斩击，造成物理伤害和冰属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes forward, dealing Physical DMG and Ice DMG.

basic.name: 登场技：霜迸
basic.description:
照的[霜寒值]满，且处于接战状态下时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方连续攻击，随后发动斩击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，消耗所有[霜寒值]，开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]；
招式发动时，触发[快速支援]，此时如果发动队友的[快速支援]，照将自动衔接[普通攻击：最终裁决]并进行蓄力；
招式发动时视为发动[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
When Zhao has maximum Frostbite Points, and is in combat, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks forward, followed by a slash, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a Quick Assist.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 特殊技：碎冰溢寒
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，消耗5%当前生命值，使全队角色每秒基于照1.06%最大生命值回复生命值，持续5秒，[特殊技：碎冰溢寒]和[强化特殊技：流霜冻土]的消耗生命效果每30秒最多触发一次。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to 1.06% of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge and EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra can trigger at most once every 30s.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：流霜冻土
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方连续发动斩击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，消耗5%当前生命值，使全队角色每秒基于照1.06%最大生命值回复生命值，持续5秒，[特殊技：碎冰溢寒]和[强化特殊技：流霜冻土]的消耗生命效果每30秒最多触发一次；
招式发动时，积攒20点[霜寒值]，如果[霜寒值]满，消耗所有[霜寒值]，开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]；
招式发动时，如果处于任意[以太帷幕]中，将触发[快速支援]，此时如果发动队友的[快速支援]，照将自动衔接[普通攻击：最终裁决]并进行蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launches multiple forward slashes, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to 1.06% of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge and EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra can trigger at most once every 30s.
Upon activating this skill, gain 20 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：兔兔连斩
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方连续攻击，随后下落斩击敌人，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动后，积攒20点[霜寒值]，如果[霜寒值]满，消耗所有[霜寒值]，开启[以太帷幕·涌泉]；
招式发动后，如果处于任意[以太帷幕]中，将触发[快速支援]，此时如果发动队友的[快速支援]，照将自动衔接[普通攻击：最终裁决]并进行蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks in front, followed by a falling slash, dealing massive Ice DMG.
After using this skill, gains 20 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：查漏补缺
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方发动下落斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches a falling slash in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
